subject: Request: short publishable compliance blurb for case study
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Casey Morales <casey@atlanticpayments.com>, Ruth Lim <ruth.lim@atlanticpayments.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short publishable compliance blurb for case study

Hi Casey and Ruth,

Thanks again for agreeing to the case study — we really appreciate Atlantic Payments opening up about the integration. Legal asked for a very small, "publishable" compliance snippet we can drop into the public case study page referencing Atlantic Payments' attestation (SOC 2 / ISO) so prospective customers can see there was an independent audit.

Two asks: 1) can you confirm the exact wording Atlantic is comfortable with (one short paragraph, ~2-3 sentences) that we can publish verbatim, and 2) please confirm whether we can link to Atlantic's public attestation page (if you have a URL).

If easier, attached is an example short paragraph other customers have approved for similar pages. Happy to adapt to whatever language you prefer.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: example-publishable-soc2-paragraph.txt

From: Casey Morales <casey@atlanticpayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ruth Lim <ruth.lim@atlanticpayments.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short publishable compliance blurb for case study

Jordan —

Thanks for the note. We can provide a short, legal-approved paragraph. Attaching our standard publishable attestation blurb (PDF) and a link to the public attestation page.

Quick question for your legal/marketing: do you need a quoted testimonial from our Head of Security, or just a factual attestation paragraph? We can do either but the approvals differ.

Attached: Atlantic_AP-soc2-publishable-paragraph.pdf
Public attestation: https://status.atlanticpayments.com/attestations/soc2-2025

—Casey
Casey Morales
Director, Platform Security | Atlantic Payments
casey@atlanticpayments.com

Thanks, that works. Legal prefers the factual attestation paragraph (no quoted testimonial) to keep the approval path quick. If the attached PDF is fine as-is we can drop it into the draft case study and include the public link you shared.

I'll flag Monica (CC) to add the attestation paragraph into the web copy and track approvals. Monica — once we have final permission from Atlantic to use the paragraph and link, please insert under the "Security & Compliance" section and push the draft to the review doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-CaseStudyDraft

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 May 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: short publishable compliance blurb for case study

Jordan / Monica —

Reviewed Atlantic's attached paragraph. Minor edits below to keep the language tight and within our legal-approved scope. Please use this exact wording when publishing:  

"Atlantic Payments maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation for its payments platform. A summary of the attestation is publicly available at https://status.atlanticpayments.com/attestations/soc2-2025. Redwood Inference's integration with Atlantic runs under Atlantic's audited controls and does not alter Atlantic's attestation scope."

Notes: 1) we removed any implication about report distribution (no full report excerpts) and 2) do not attach Atlantic's full SOC 2 report to the public page. If Atlantic wants a short quote from their Head of Security, we'll need a signed permission form — not necessary for the factual blurb.

Attaching our redwood-approved-soc2-blurb.docx for tracking.

—Grace O'Connor
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-approved-soc2-blurb.docx

From: Casey Morales <casey@atlanticpayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ruth Lim <ruth.lim@atlanticpayments.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short publishable compliance blurb for case study

Thanks everyone — that wording is fine. Atlantic grants permission to publish the exact paragraph Grace provided and to link to our public attestation page. We confirm we do not want the full SOC 2 report published.

One final note: if Redwood prefers a short credited sentence from our Head of Security in addition to the factual blurb, we can provide a one-sentence testimonial; we'll need a quick sign-off via DocuSign. Otherwise proceed with the factual blurb.

Permission granted by: Casey Morales, Director, Platform Security, Atlantic Payments
casey@atlanticpayments.com
